title: Agentic REPL (grouped) input
description: Grouped action-parameter tool consolidating repl.render and repl.validate. Select the per-action body via the top-level `action` discriminator. Each branch reproduces the exact body of the corresponding per-action input schema, with `action` added to the allowed property set. Per-action handlers, schemas, and the external repl_render/repl_validate tools are unchanged; this is a zero-functionality-loss bolt-on.

action.description: Selects the per-action handler. 'render' -> repl.render, 'validate' -> repl.validate.

schemaRef.description: Reference to a cached UiSchema returned by design.compose.

brand.description: Brand to render. Optional with NO default: omitting it preserves the previous behaviour byte-for-byte, including the document's data-brand="default". Uppercase 'A' or 'B' exactly. Applies to output.format='document' only — the 'fragments' branch emits no <html> element to carry data-brand, so fragments diagnose an ignored brand with OODS-W001.

output.description: Optional render output controls. Omitting this object preserves full-document behavior.

compact.description: Opt in to omitting token CSS; the default includes token CSS.

showConfidence.description: When true, emit data-oods-confidence and data-confidence-level attributes on rendered components that carry composition confidence metadata. Low-confidence components (below confidenceThreshold) also receive an oods-low-confidence CSS class. Default false.

confidenceThreshold.description: Confidence threshold for low-confidence affordance. Components with confidence below this value receive the oods-low-confidence CSS class. Only effective when showConfidence is true. Default 0.5.

tokenOverlay.description: Inline token-delta object resolved to a scoped :root{} override; applied only in document output (format=document), diagnosed as ignored for fragments with OODS-W001; distinct from the FS-resolved named brandOverlay on fidelity.preview.

skinOverlay.description: Inline measured-COLOUR delta resolved against the OODS Foundry-owned style library to a scoped :root{} override on the --sys-/--ref- skin (distinct from tokenOverlay's --oods- token path); applied only in document output (format=document), gated by apply===true. An unmapped logical key fails loud with OODS-V140. Lands in the same components <style> block as tokenOverlay; default-absent is byte-identical.

payloadMode.description: Unset: inline, unless the output would exceed 100,000 characters, in which case it is written as with file and warning OODS-W004 says so. inline returns html (or fragments and css) in the response. file writes index.html (or fragments.json and css.json) beside the saved-schema store (<store>/../payloads/repl.render-<digest>/) and returns a payload block of file references instead; html, fragments and css are then omitted.

apply.description: When true and the schema validates, render it: the HTML document in html, or per-node fragments with output.format 'fragments'. Omitted or false is a dry run that validates and returns the tree with no HTML.

schemaRef.description: Reference to a cached UiSchema returned by design.compose.

patch.description: Required when mode='patch'. Accepts JSON Patch array or node patch object(s).

baseTree.description: Required when mode='patch' to provide the base UiSchema to patch.

checkA11y.description: Checks declared foreground/background pairs derived from shared component CSS against current built tokens for every registered brand and theme, including team brands. With a UiSchema, renders through the shared HTML renderer and checks document language/title, one main landmark, unique IDs, ARIA reference targets, control names/labels, image alternatives, chart SVG name/description, and heading names/order. Reports unresolved inherited surfaces, dynamic CSS, alpha compositing and OS colours as unmeasured. Does not check browser-computed colour/layout, keyboard/focus interaction or screen-reader behavior; no complete WCAG conformance claim.

apply.description: Accepted for bridge dry-run/apply mode parity (this tool is apply-capable); ignored by this action.
